title: Prepare temperature-dependent thermoelectric material properties
action: Read the provided temperature-dependent Seebeck coefficient, electrical conductivity, and thermal conductivity data for p-type and n-type CoSb3 and Bi2Te3. Create interpolation functions α(T), σ(T), κ(T) for each material to be used in the subsequent simulation.
description: Interpolate material property curves from supplied data.

title: Implement the discrete numerical model (DNM) and the Improved Powell optimizer
action: Implement the DNM solver that computes the temperature distribution, current, and performance metrics P_m and η for given geometry. Implement the Improved Powell Algorithm with constraint handling.
description: Code implementation of core numerical methods.

title: Run optimization for maximum specific output power (base case)
action: Perform optimization for maximum specific output power (minimize -P_m) with L=4 mm, A_p=3×3 mm², T_h=823 K, T_c=298 K, R_con=0. Record optimal S_nh_opt, S_ph_opt, a_opt, P_m_max, and the corresponding η.

title: Run optimization for maximum conversion efficiency (base case)
action: Perform optimization for maximum conversion efficiency (minimize -η) with same base parameters. Record optimal parameters, η_max, and corresponding P_m.

title: Compile final optimization results
action: Combine the two optimization results into a single JSON file with structure: { "max_power": { "S_nh_opt":..., "S_ph_opt":..., "a_opt":..., "P_m_max":..., "eta_max":... }, "max_efficiency": { ... } }. All numeric values to at least three decimal places for geometry and two decimal places for performance.
description: Final compilation of base-case optimal results.
output_schema: {"max_power": {"S_nh_opt": float, "S_ph_opt": float, "a_opt": float, "P_m_max": float (W/kg), "eta_max": float (%)}, "max_efficiency": {"S_nh_opt": float, "S_ph_opt": float, "a_opt": float, "P_m_max": float (W/kg), "eta_max": float (%)}}
